_note: The request API (robofast_core/request_api.py; docs/design.md 3.7), the one internet-facing service.
python -m robofast_core.request_api tokens add --config ... --name my-tom --scope read --scope submit
It listens on loopback behind a TLS reverse proxy (deploy/nginx-request-api.conf, deploy/Caddyfile.request-api).
tokens: the hashed tokens file. Keep it outside any repository (the CLI refuses a path inside a git work tree).
There are no default tokens: until one is added, every request is refused.
enclosures: each enclosure's config (shared with its supervisor and sequencer) and, when the sequencer
runs with --plan, that dispatch plan file; the API reads the scheduler's state file and writes the drop box.
Give the enclosure config a status_file (robofast_core/sequencer_service.py) for per-telescope state in GET /status.
data_path_template: where frames are expected to land (no files are served); fields: enclosure, night,
telescope, group, request, configuration, instrument_config, frame.
The API speaks the LCO OCS request language and endpoints under /api (docs/request_language.md), so a TOM
uses TOM Toolkit's OCSFacility with settings only (docs/tom_facility.md). proposals: what clients may submit
under (and their TOM form offers); telescope_class: MINERVA's 0.7 m telescopes in OCS terms; site_code: the
